purpose: Preregistered complete finite-subgame graph diagnostic; fresh current-key-once history only. No production cache/search/game comparison. No arbitrary-history or strength claim. All exclusions/partial attempts retained.

certificates.drawProof: For each residual nonterminal, a stored successor remains residual or terminal draw; all exits to opponent-win states can be avoided. Against any opponent, an outcome better for that opponent is never forced. Finite residual play either reaches stalemate or repeats a position three times. Winning rank decreases on chosen winner moves and all loser responses, precluding repeats from current-key-once fresh history. Earlier repetition counts excluded.
